podcast.body: The third single from Fun Lovin' Criminals' debut album "Come Find Yourself." It was their only significant hit in North America, but became an immediate hit in the UK, selling 200,000 copies, and was popular on Alt Rock Radio in Canada and the US. The song's title refers to Valium pills, called "Scooby Stacks," handed out by bouncers at The Tunnel, a New York club, to calm patrons. It famously features samples from Quentin Tarantino's movies "Reservoir Dogs" and "Pulp Fiction." Tarantino demanded and received 37% of all royalties and a songwriting credit, making him an official co-writer. As of February 2026, it had 49.2 million Spotify plays and 5.8 million YouTube views, totaling 55 million, with a One Hit Wonder Power Rating of 4.20 out of 10. "First, the song's title is a reference to taking volume."
